promptEs: ¿Cómo se deletrea la escala de Do menor armónica?
explanationEs: Do menor armónica se deletrea C D Eb F G Ab B C con el séptimo grado elevado.
choices: C D Eb F G Ab B C
C D Eb F G Ab Bb C

promptEn: How do you spell the C harmonic minor scale?
explanationEn: C harmonic minor is spelled C D Eb F G Ab B C with the raised seventh degree.
choicesEn: C D Eb F G Ab B C
C D Eb F G Ab Bb C
C D Eb F G A B C
